WITH trader_compliance AS (
    SELECT 
        t."TR_KEY" AS trader_id,
        SUM(CAST(r."compliance_data"->>'prev_viol' AS integer)) AS total_prev_viol,
        MAX(CASE WHEN r."compliance_data"->>'comp_rate' IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_bad_rating,
        MAX(t."trader_fin_data"->>'age_days')::integer AS account_age_days
    FROM reg_compliance r
    JOIN trade_records tr ON r."REC_COMP" = tr."REC_KEY"
    JOIN traders t ON tr."tr_anchor" = t."TR_KEY"
    GROUP BY t."TR_KEY"
),
trader_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        trader_id,
        total_prev_viol,
        has_bad_rating,
        account_age_days,
        CAST(total_prev_viol AS numeric) / GREATEST(1.0, CAST(account_age_days AS numeric) / 365.0) AS crs
    FROM trader_compliance
)
SELECT 
    trader_id,
    ROUND(crs, 2) AS compliance_recidivism_score
FROM trader_scores
WHERE total_prev_viol > 3 OR has_bad_rating = 1 OR crs > 1.0
